Hi John,

Thanks for the meeting. Decisions: phase‑two rollout starts 10 Feb 2026; weekly status calls moved to Tuesdays 10:00; reporting dashboard will use revised metric definitions.

Action items:
- Dana will circulate the revised rollout timeline by 9 Jan.
- Priya will confirm dashboard metric definitions with the data team.
- All will prepare the phase‑two risk register before the next status call.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
